voyage across the ocean: In the past, a voyage across the ocean could take months, and many sailors became sick on the way.
過去橫渡海洋的航行可能要花好幾個月，許多水手在途中生病。
a voyage of discovery: For many students, the first year of college is a voyage of discovery about who they really are.
對許多學生來說，大學第一年是一趟了解自己真正是誰的探索之旅。
maiden voyage: The famous Titanic sank during its maiden voyage in 1912 after it hit an iceberg.
著名的鐵達尼號在1912年首航時撞上冰山而沉沒。
wage war: The two kingdoms continued to wage war against each other for nearly a hundred years.
這兩個王國持續對彼此發動戰爭將近一百年。
wage a campaign: The students decided to wage a campaign against single-use plastic bags in the school store.
學生們決定發起一場運動，反對學校福利社使用一次性塑膠袋。
wage a battle against: Doctors around the world continue to wage a battle against cancer by developing new medicines.
世界各地的醫生持續研發新藥，對抗癌症。
wage a struggle: Workers in the factory had to wage a struggle for years before they finally got safer working conditions.
工廠裡的工人進行了多年的鬥爭，才終於得到更安全的工作環境。
minimum wage: The government raised the minimum wage this year, so part-time workers now earn more per hour.
政府今年調高了最低工資，所以兼職人員現在每小時賺得更多。
wait on tables: During the summer vacation, my cousin worked at a restaurant to wait on tables and earn some pocket money.
暑假期間，我表哥在一家餐廳當服務生，賺點零用錢。
wait one's turn: Please stand in line and wait your turn; everyone will get a chance to try the new game.
請排隊等輪到你；每個人都會有機會試玩這款新遊戲。
wait and see: We don't know yet if the typhoon will hit Taipei, so we will have to wait and see.
我們還不知道颱風會不會襲擊台北，所以只能等著瞧。
wait in the wings: Our star player is getting old, but several talented young players are waiting in the wings to take his place.
我們的明星球員年紀大了，但有好幾個有天分的年輕球員正在等待時機取代他。
can't wait: I can't wait to see my best friend again, because she has been studying in Japan for a whole year.
我等不及要再見到我最好的朋友，因為她已經在日本讀書整整一年了。
wait up: I'll be home very late tonight, so please don't wait up for me and go to bed early.
我今晚會很晚回家，所以請不要等門，早點去睡。
lie in wait: In the jungle, a hungry tiger may lie in wait behind the bushes until a deer comes close.
在叢林裡，飢餓的老虎可能會埋伏在灌木叢後面，直到鹿靠近。
waive a fee: The museum agreed to waive a fee for students who show their school ID cards at the entrance.
博物館同意替在入口出示學生證的學生免除費用。
waive one's rights: Before you sign this paper, make sure you understand that you will waive your rights to ask for a refund.
在你簽這份文件之前，要確定你了解你將放棄要求退款的權利。
waive the requirement: Because of her excellent grades, the university decided to waive the requirement of an interview for her.
因為她成績優異，大學決定免除她面試的要求。
waive the rule: Normally no food is allowed in the library, but the librarian waived the rule for the exam week.
圖書館平常不准帶食物，但圖書館員在考試週不適用這條規定。
wake up to the danger: Many smokers do not wake up to the danger of their habit until a doctor shows them an X-ray of their lungs.
許多吸菸者直到醫生給他們看肺部X光片，才意識到這個習慣的危險。
wake up and smell the coffee: You can't pass the exam without studying, so it's time to wake up and smell the coffee.
你不讀書是不可能考過的，所以是時候認清現實了。
wake memories: The smell of my grandmother's cooking can wake memories of happy summers in the countryside.
奶奶做菜的香味能喚起我在鄉下度過的快樂夏天的回憶。
in the wake of: In the wake of the strong earthquake, many buildings were checked to make sure they were still safe.
在強烈地震之後，許多建築物都接受檢查，以確保它們仍然安全。
wake the dead: The music from the party next door was loud enough to wake the dead, so nobody on our street could sleep.
隔壁派對的音樂吵得震天響，所以我們這條街上沒有人睡得著。
wander off topic: Our history teacher often wanders off topic and tells us funny stories about his school days.
我們歷史老師常常偏離主題，跟我們說他學生時代的趣事。
one's mind wanders: When the lecture is long and boring, my mind wanders and I start thinking about what to eat for lunch.
當演講又長又無聊時，我的心思飄走，開始想午餐要吃什麼。
wander the streets: On our first night in Tainan, we decided to wander the streets and try different local snacks.
我們在台南的第一晚，決定在街上閒晃，品嚐各種在地小吃。
wander from the path: The little boy began to wander from the path, chasing butterflies here and there, and soon got lost.
小男孩開始偏離路徑，東追西追蝴蝶，很快就迷路了。
wandering attention: Short videos with bright colors are used to catch the wandering attention of young children in class.
色彩鮮豔的短影片被用來吸引課堂上幼童渙散的注意力。
